name: smooth-scroll
blurb: Smooth scrolling behavior applied to the entire page.
description: A page wrapper that applies smooth scrolling physics using ReactLenis. Demonstrates smooth scroll with sticky sections revealing on scroll.
use_when: A full-page experience where smooth scrolling enhances the visual feel and engagement.
avoid_when: When you need accessibility-first design or users prefer reduced motion — smooth scrolling can interfere with predictable scroll behavior.
a11y: Smooth scrolling is applied site-wide but respects prefers-reduced-motion if configured. Can interfere with scroll-based animations.
